host.description: URI exposing the Livebox API. May also be provided via LIVEBOX_HOST environment variable.

password.description: Password for accessing the Livebox API. May also be provided via LIVEBOX_PASSWORD environment variable.

block.description: A terraform provider to interact with a Livebox. It currently only supports configuring port forwarding rules.

destination.description: IP address to forward traffic to.

enabled.description: Whether this port forwarding rule is enabled or not.

external_port.description: External port of the port forwarding rule to create.

internal_port.description: Internal port of the port forwarding rule to create.

name.description: Arbitrary but unique name of the port forwarding rule to create.

port_range.description: If set, forwards a range of consecutive ports instead of one.

protocol.description: Protocol of the port forwarding rule to create. Must be one of: "tcp", "udp" or "tcp/udp"

source.description: Allowed external IP addresses to forward traffic from, separated by commas.

block.description: Configure a port forwarding rule on a Livebox.
